name: Reway Group S.p.A.
summary: Reway Group S.p.A., operating primarily through its subsidiaries, is a specialist in the rehabilitation and enhancement of road and motorway infrastructure across Italy. Its comprehensive services include the refurbishment of bridges, viaducts, and tunnels, along with detailed tunnel finishing work. The company also undertakes the installation of acoustic and safety barriers for road and motorway environments. Furthermore, Reway Group provides seismic reinforcement for bridges and viaducts, and performs general restoration for a wide array of civil engineering structures. Additional capabilities extend to structural repairs and lifting operations for viaducts, as well as civil works for railway tunnels and ongoing tunnel maintenance. Founded in 1994, the company's base is located in Licciana Nardi, Italy.
